description.fallback: The group is finally crossing India, albeit worriedly. India is known for having beggars, thieves, curry-eating and disease-ridden people. Avdol assures them that it is a nice country and that all these stories are false.

text.fallback: Head out: Emperor and Hanged Man, Part 1

outro.fallback: As he washes his hands, Polnareff looks into the mirror and is surprised by a Stand with two right hands that he can only see in the mirror.
Determined to avenge his sister, killed by the user of this Stand, Polnareff breaks the mirror and searches for the Stand user among the crowd.
